description.ko: CPU 카탈로그와 실제 호출 선언의 이름 후보·계약 차이 비교. 이름 일치는 구현 증거가 아니다.
description.en: CPU catalog rows compared with concrete export name candidates and known contract differences; no implementation completion inferred.

rules: All1936 catalog rows retain exact written signatures, return text and provenance; historical documentation duplicates remain traceable.
Only explicit manifest mappings are called equivalents; same-name exports are candidate links, not exact semantic, overload, lifetime or execution matches.
Unmapped rows may be compiler intrinsic operations. They are not automatically counted as absent.
Compiler-generated placeholders have provider_declaration only; typed results require frontend/AIR/runtime contract evidence.

known_contract_differences.difference: Same operation name does not imply the exact error type or static namespace calling form.
The source optional success index omits the catalog insertion-position outcome. Array/Vector need explicit borrowed Slice adaptation.
Existing source is stable O(n^2) insertion sort with Copy elements; it is not a full move-only unstable-sort catalog contract.
Explicit source module, error carrier and sometimes fallibility differ. UTF-8 boundaries and empty delimiter policy must be reconciled.

known_contract_differences.catalog_return: Lazy iterator contracts in the text catalog
known_contract_differences.difference: Token bytes borrow the original UTF-8 input; collecting descriptors allocates explicitly and reports allocation/size failures. Empty-delimiter splitting advances at Unicode scalar boundaries, not graphemes. Local accepted, lifetime-negative and injected-allocation gates pass, but this is not a lazy catalog iterator.

known_contract_differences.source_return: Explicit F and owning EntryInputError/EntryBuildError carriers
known_contract_differences.difference: Callback is stored concretely, and vacant insertion rechecks its transient slot; the additional Insertion error retains completed input. The full scoped accepted/lifetime-negative/allocation-recovery gate passes on b18f9833; this does not erase the calling-form and error differences.
Source steps are O(log n), O(n log n) overall, rather than the linear traversal contract. Mutable and key/value adapters are not implied.
Occupied owns both incoming owners explicitly; it is not InputError.OutOfBounds.

Current char_source_checkpoint.json maps2 direct Char scalar bindings and105 explicit unicode source alternatives:76 same return carriers,29 adapted UnicodeError carriers. Unicode17 data supplies50 property/case/name operations; it does not provide whole-string normalization, locale/context casing, collation, segmentation or bidi layout. Source alternatives do not enable the other105 Char namespace spellings.

known_contract_differences.source: math f32/f64 scalar wrappers and FloatMathError helpers
known_contract_differences.difference: 42 native C symbol pairs and local checks do not supply f16/bf16 overloads, correctly-rounded cross-platform guarantees, lgamma or the complete Float/Complex catalogs.

known_contract_differences.catalog_return: Typed operation contracts in design tables
known_contract_differences.source_return: Compiler-defined typed results, not void provider placeholders
known_contract_differences.difference: Provider declarations are not callable signatures. Named-argument restrictions, supported scalar widths, transfer permissions and source gates need individual evidence.

known_contract_differences.source: Sealed owned-worker Task<T>/TaskScope profile plus independent cancellation capabilities
known_contract_differences.source_return: Compiler-checked Task/Scope results and explicitly fallible cancellation clone/derivation
known_contract_differences.difference: Twenty-five of59 canonical Task names have callable candidates, plus the extra blocking Task.wait.20 closed runtime-bound operations,5 cancellation aliases and deadline_after expose26 source surfaces. The34 names without providers split into24 synchronous0.3 and10 async0.4 targets. Fallible cancellation returns Result, request_cancel returns TaskCancelRequest, and ScopeStatus currently has Open/Closing only. Owned captures/results, lexical Scope provenance, worker cleanup/effects and one native thread per child remain bounded. A name match is not exact signature or full-catalog proof.

known_contract_differences.catalog: Byte explicit codecs, scalar bits, strict text and overlap copying
known_contract_differences.source: bytes module with128 ordinary source functions and16 ByteError variants; imported shared ordering.Ordering
known_contract_differences.source_return: Actual source signatures, including wide integer/float codecs and Result<unit,bytes.ByteError> copy_within
known_contract_differences.difference: Explicit-endian codecs, scalar bits, overlap-safe bounded operations, owning buffer allocation/growth and strict UTF8 adapters now have scoped gates. Native-endian codecs and lazy iterator contracts remain separate. Source namespace, error identity, preallocation/mutation policies, borrowed lifetimes and every129-row catalog signature still require individual reconciliation. UTF8 decoding explicitly validates again before copying.

known_contract_differences.catalog_return: Owned text and conceptual DecodeError/EncodeError contracts
known_contract_differences.source: Canonical owned-string decode_utf8/decode_utf16/decode_ascii; explicit *_scalars foundation helpers; endian-byte and UTF32 codecs
known_contract_differences.source_return: Result<string,EncodingError> or explicitly named scalar Vector<u32> helpers; validate_utf8 returns Result<usize,EncodingError>
known_contract_differences.difference: Canonical owned-text results now match the intended output category, while unified EncodingError and count-returning validation remain explicit differences. Stateless codec gates do not implement streaming/lossy/transcode policies.

known_contract_differences.catalog_return: Representation conversion contracts in Float catalog
known_contract_differences.source: Exact compiler-owned Float intrinsics for f16/bf16/u16, f32/u32, f64/u64
known_contract_differences.source_return: Requested float or same-width unsigned integer, not Result
known_contract_differences.difference: Representation reinterpretation preserves every payload bit, including signed zero and NaN payloads; it is not numeric conversion and does not add f8 or implicit widening. Builtin identity and same-name module rejection/selection are checked independently.

known_contract_differences.catalog_return: Borrowed scalar inspection of integer descriptors
known_contract_differences.source_return: Endpoint type, same-width unsigned step magnitude, or bool
known_contract_differences.difference: Seven concrete compiler intrinsics inspect a borrowed descriptor without consumption or iteration progress. step aliases step_magnitude. General iterator emptiness does not dictate buffer-specific reversed-extent policy.

known_contract_differences.catalog_return: Three-way comparison result used by catalog operations
known_contract_differences.source: Imported ordering.Ordering implements Copy; bytes reexports the identical enum
known_contract_differences.source_return: Less/Equal/Greater with ten pure source helpers
known_contract_differences.difference: Common source type, not a primitive/prelude or a rewrite of existing i32 comparator callbacks. Integer conversion is explicit -1/0/1 and does not expose enum ABI.

known_contract_differences.source: Explicit import boolean and20 free functions
known_contract_differences.difference: Source callbacks use concrete FnOnce bounds. format/format_into return boolean.BooleanError rather than conceptual AllocError/BufferError. This adds no Boolean namespace forwarding.

known_contract_differences.source: Explicit import integer with528 overloads,48 function names and24 constants
known_contract_differences.difference: integer.IntegerArithmeticError remains distinct from canonical IntegerError. Fixed primitive overloads and constants do not implement the entire136-row catalog, type-operand APIs, wide parsing/formatting or namespace facade.

known_contract_differences.source: Explicit import floating with108 functions over f16,bf16,f32,f64
known_contract_differences.difference: Classification, sign, next-value, total order and format constants preserve payload/signed-zero policies. The source utilities do not supply all228 catalog signatures or wider special-function and SIMD math contracts.

next_pure_source_batches.reason: Provide original-owner-backed Slice cursors before lazy Array/Vector and Optional/Result adapters. Existing all/any/fold/search helpers already exist; wrappers alone are not new algorithms.
requirements: Preserve the original data-owner loan through copied/carried cursor descriptors.
Test multiple live readonly items, reverse exhaustion, zero-width rejection and source/cursor destruction.
Mutable iterators require disjointness proof; do not use overlapping mutable views.

next_pure_source_batches.module: remaining lazy byte iterators and native-endian policies
next_pure_source_batches.reason: The current128-function bytes profile includes owning buffers and strict UTF8 adapters; lazy views and target-native byte order still need separate ownership and target rules.
requirements: Preserve accepted input owners on fallible growth and validate sizes before mutation.
Borrowed lazy iterators must retain the original input owner through copies and nested carriers.
Native-endian operations require target-endian semantics rather than compiler-host order.
